title: Half Moon Wrench Left
introduction:
A half-moon wrench helps you reach a fastener around an obstruction. Its shape and the way it sits on the torque wrench affect the setting needed at the handle. Match the left or right arrangement in the original illustration before choosing the supported wrench and adapter combination below.

The calculator adjusts the wrench setting for that arrangement. The fastener specification still comes from the repair you are doing; this page does not choose a torque for the car.

checks.notes: Calculator UI preserves and verifies original mathematical behavior; all source illustrations retained.
